UNSDG-subregion: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) subregion country associated . worldBankIncomeGroup: World Bank income group country associated . admUnitCount: number administrative units boundary. meanVertices: mean number vertices defining boundaries administrative unit layer. minVertices: minimum number vertices defining boundary. maxVertices: maximum number vertices defining boundary. minPerimeterLengthKM: minimum perimeter length administrative unit layer, measured kilometers based World Equidistant Cylindrical projection. meanPerimeterLengthKM: mean perimeter length administrative unit layer, measured kilometers based World Equidistant Cylindrical projection. maxPerimeterLengthKM: maximum perimeter length administrative unit layer, measured kilometers based World Equidistant Cylindrical projection. meanAreaSqKM: mean area administrative units layer, measured square kilometers based EASE-GRID 2 projection. minAreaSqKM: minimum area administrative unit layer, measured square kilometers based EASE-GRID 2 projection. maxAreaSqKM: maximum area administrative unit layer, measured square kilometers based EASE-GRID 2 projection. staticDownloadLink: static download link aggregate ZIP file containing boundary information. gjDownloadURL: static download link GeoJSON. tjDownloadURL: static download link TopoJSON. imagePreview: static download link automatically rendered PNG image layer. simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON: static download link simplified GeoJSON.

title: Download country boundaries for one ADM level — gb_get_adm
text: functions call gb_get() single ADM level. gb_get_adm0() returns country boundaries, gb_get_adm1() returns first-level subnational boundaries (example, states United States) gb_get_adm2() returns second-level subnational boundaries (example, counties United States). gb_get_adm3(), gb_get_adm4() gb_get_adm5() return third-, fourth- fifth-level administrative boundaries, respectively. title: geobounds 1.0.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-09-05 Argument errors now display braces supplied values literally instead interpreting message formatting. Numeric text ADM levels "1" now resolve corresponding code, "ADM1". Country inputs now reject empty wholly unmatched values, Kosovo aliases must match "Kosovo" "XKX" exactly. gb_clear_cache() now rejects unsafe cache locations recursively deleting cached data. Cache functions also validate scalar arguments, report directory creation failures clearly confirm requested deletions succeeded. gb_get() now returns NULL downloaded boundaries available. also rejects missing non-scalar download options invalid cache directory values requesting data. Invalid cached archives removed actionable error subsequent request can download . gb_get_max_adm_lvl() now derives maximum level ADM label instead assuming available metadata levels consecutive. gb_get_world() now returns NULL download fails requested country available. also validates download options requesting data.

title: geobounds 0.1.0
text: Functions downloading boundaries renamed follow convention object_verb() (see https://devguide.ropensci.org/pkg_building.html): get_gb() -> gb_get(). ?get_gb_adm family -> ?gb_get_adm family. get_gb_cgaz() -> gb_get_world(). gb_get_cgaz() also available backward compatibility alias gb_get_world(). get_gb_meta() -> gb_get_metadata(). Additionally, metadata argument removed. Use gb_get_metadata() instead.

title: geobounds 0.1.0
text: Added DOI. download functions now use .zip archives containing .shp files instead .geojson .gpkg files, removing geojsonsf dependency Imports. download functions now return MULTIPOLYGON geometries. download functions now return NULL without error warning country file unavailable. download functions now retry transient request failures httr2::req_retry(). Cached files previous package versions longer reused source archive format changed. Country matching now improves detection Antarctica Kosovo. gb_get*() functions now allow mixed country argument types, gb_get(country = c("Germany", "USA")). gb_get_adm5() added. gb_get_max_adm_lvl() added. gb_get_world() now retrieves latest boundaries available repository https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/tree/main/releaseData.
